## Bio

Sharon attends [Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health](https://publichealth.jhu.edu/) as a part-time MPH student concentrating in Epidemiology and Biostatistics, while also working as a Senior Product Manager at [CVS Health](https://www.cvshealth.com/), optimizing use of external claims data across lines of business (Aetna, Retail, Specialty, Caremark, Healthspire).

Previously, she worked as a Senior Solutions Manager at [Flatiron Health](https://flatiron.com/), where she led knowledge management, customer success, and feature rollouts for the Real-World Evidence (RWE) business in support of cancer researchers, and as a Consultant at [Simon-Kucher](https://www.simon-kucher.com/en), where she delivered go-to-market pricing and market access strategies to support drug launches across 10+ countries. She also holds a Bachelor's degree in Economics from the [University of Chicago](https://www.uchicago.edu/en).

Sharon is passionate about leveraging data to drive impactful decisions and improve public health outcomes.

## Interests

-   Observational Research

-   Oncology

-   Mental Health

-   Board Games

-   Hiking

## Projects

-   [CHAI](https://www.clintonhealthaccess.org/): Cleaned and analyzed patient chart-abstracted data to support program evaluation of Nigeria Cancer Access Partnership ([NCAP](https://www.alliedagainstcancer.org/access-partnership))'s impact on patient access to affordable drugs, adherence, and outcomes.

-   Crisis counseling: Conducted exploratory analysis to evaluate the real-world performance and impact of deploying an LLM-based copilot at scale in a WhatsApp-based crisis counseling service in India.

-   [ICER evaluation](https://www.valueinhealthjournal.com/article/S1098-3015(21)00350-8/fulltext): Supported study design and analysis for a replication of an Institute of Clinical and Economic Review (ICER) cost-effectiveness analysis of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) therapies using electronic health record (EHR) data from Flatiron Health.
